title: SourceOccurrence
description: One URL, at one rank, in one specific query's result set. Deliberately independent of content: a page reachable from three queries is three occurrences over one CanonicalSnapshot. Collapsing them would erase the citation lineage every quality metric is computed against.

query_snapshot_id.description: The exact request (query text AND every retrieval parameter) this result came back from.

rank.description: 1-based position within its own query's result list.

content_hash.description: Snapshot this occurrence points at. Null when the provider returned no raw_content: such a result is NOT WEBPAGE_P1-eligible and stays on the vendor result['content'] path.

snippet_content.description: The provider's short 'content' field. This is what vendor ODR falls back to when raw_content is absent, so both arms must receive it identically.

visibility.description: Which view this occurrence belongs to. VENDOR_VISIBLE reproduces the URL-deduped first-occurrence view that vendor tavily_search actually builds, and is the ONLY view a primary selector may read. AUDIT_ONLY occurrences (later duplicates of an already-seen URL) exist for provenance and evaluation; exposing their rank/diversity metadata to P1 would hand the treatment arm information P0 never had.

duplicate_of_occurrence_id.description: For AUDIT_ONLY rows: the VENDOR_VISIBLE occurrence that won URL dedup.

vendor_visible_order.description: 0-based position in the vendor's first-occurrence ordering. Null for AUDIT_ONLY rows. Fixes the order in which sources are presented so P0 and P1 see the same sequence.
